record: V4 accounting limitation — mine-tag was outside the frozen tactical bucket
limitation: V4's frozen gate defined tactical_channels = [tag, enemy_mav_kill, mine_tag] but mine-tag was marked UNRESOLVED at freeze time because no measured rate existed. The reported 'tactical shaping = 0.0%' is therefore true only under the V4 accounting as frozen: tag and enemy_mav_kill were both zeroed, and mine-tag's contribution was not yet quantifiable.

what_is_now_known.verdict: a direct, repeatable tactical payoff — not negligible

correction_going_forward: From V5 onward, mine-tag is classified as TACTICAL SHAPING and counted in the tactical budget. V4's reported figure is not retroactively restated; this record exists so the historical number is not read as 'V4 had no tactical shaping at all'.

offense_channel_audit.status: read-only audit performed before V5; NO EXPLOIT FOUND, offense left unchanged
offense_channel_audit.concern_tested: pickup -> drop -> pickup oscillation farming the +0.1 flag_pickup_reward

evidence_against.reasoning: An oscillation farm would show drop_per_pickup near 1.0 with near-zero captures. Observed captures per episode are high (2.56-2.78) and roughly half of pickups convert, so grabs are productive rather than churned.

offense_channel_audit.flag_for_v5: grab reward is ~50% of terminal per episode. It is PROGRESS shaping (a pickup is genuine progress toward a capture), not tactical shaping, but it is now the largest remaining shaping channel and should be reported explicitly in V5 budget panels.
